name: What is City Dweller, LLC's remodeling process from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is City Dweller, LLC's remodeling process from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our remodeling process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop a detailed design and provide a transparent proposal. Once approved, we handle permit acquisition and material selection. Construction then begins, managed by our experienced team with regular client updates. We prioritize cleanliness and efficiency on-site. The project concludes with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction before handover. We aim for a smooth and stress-free experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, proposal, permitting, material selection, construction with regular updates, and a final walkthrough for client satisfaction.
